description: Source file implementing functions and classes for handling AVC (H.264) parameter sets and conversion between Annex B and AVCC formats in media processing.

classes.name: AvcParameterSets
classes.description: Class managing AVC parameter sets, parsing from Annex B format, and converting to other formats.

methods.name: StartsWithAnnexBHeader
methods.description: Checks if data starts with Annex B header.

methods.name: AdvanceToNextAnnexBHeader
methods.description: Advances pointer to next Annex B header in data.

methods.name: ExtractAnnexBNalu
methods.description: Extracts a NALU from Annex B formatted data.

methods.name: AvcParameterSets::AvcParameterSets
methods.description: Constructor that parses AVC parameter sets from Annex B data.

methods.name: AvcParameterSets::ConvertTo
methods.description: Converts parameter sets to a different format.

methods.name: ConvertAnnexBToAvcc
methods.description: Converts Annex B formatted data to AVCC format.
